name: rla
description: Replay registry transaction logs into dirty hives and write out clean copies.
about: A registry hive copied from a running system is usually dirty: some of its most recent changes live only in the .LOG1 and .LOG2 transaction logs beside it and have not been written back into the hive itself. rla replays those logs and writes a clean hive to an output directory, which is what other tools then read. Only hives that were actually dirty are written out unless copying everything is asked for, so the output directory shows which hives had pending changes. The directory layout the hives were found in is recreated by default, keeping per-profile hives of the same name apart.
